card.name: Linking words inside drug lists
card.fires_on: Small joining words such as 'and', 'or', 'of' or a comma right after a drug or drug class name, where another drug name is about to follow. Mostly premedication lists and drug combinations.

modes.label: Joiner in premedication list
modes.description: 'and' or a comma after a premedication drug, before the next drug in the list.
modes.example: Administer premedication consisting of dexamethasone, antihistamines (H1 and H2 blockers)<< and>> acetaminophen prior to EMPLICIT

modes.label: Joiner in drug pairs
modes.description: 'and', 'or' or 'with' linking two named drugs or drug classes.
modes.example: Trimethoprim Alone or in Combination<< with>> Sulfamethoxazole: (

modes.label: Inside drug class names
modes.description: Partway through a drug class name, just before a second class term.
modes.example: in combination with a protease<< inhibitor>> and/or nucleoside analogue reverse transcript
